admission.justification: End-to-end deterministic epistemic and Concept-First validation across local and CI runs requires pure finding/card models, shared plain-text LaTeX and concept_variants helpers, strict artifact schema checks, Concept Card and Lean-anchor verification, Level-1 jargon ordering and check-quality.sh CLI wiring to hold together.

guarantee: Invoking rh-validate locally or through scripts/check-quality.sh deterministically enforces strict audit/DAG artifact schemas, sourced Concept Cards with resolved Lean skeleton anchors and optional visuals, plain-text LaTeX hygiene on card attributes and term display overrides, zero cross-card concept-variant collisions via one shared concept_variants helper, all-level directive resolution, and Level-1 concept-first jargon order strictly under <memory>/docs/{concepts,stages}/ while leaving AR onboarding/ untouched and reporting canonically sorted diagnostics.
title: Deterministic explainer, Concept Card and artifact schema validator suite
